meta.name: four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档中整理出事实、解释、风险与行动四套要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把复杂材料压缩成结构化的讨论要点
copy.tagline_en: Distill documents into facts, insights, risks, and actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to condense complex materials into structured discussion points

howto.what: 把已解析的结构化文档和你的问题，转成四张卡片：蓝卡记可溯源的事实、绿卡讲背景与机制、黄卡列风险与不确定、红卡给下一步建议。每张卡片带来源和生成方式，便于溯源。
howto.when: 当你需要把解析后的文档与查询意图整理成可溯源的卡片，或运行 run_four_color_cards.py 的 extract、review、propose 等阶段时，它会接管。

say.text: 把这份文档整理成四色卡片
这几张卡片分别引用了哪些来源？
say.note: 绿卡引蓝卡，红卡引绿卡/蓝卡

say.text: LLM 不可用时，用规则引擎出卡片并标注
say.note: 黄卡红卡会标「未启用 LLM」

howto.what_en: Turns a parsed document plus your question into four cards: blue for source-cited facts, green for background and mechanism, yellow for risks and uncertainty, red for next steps. Each card keeps its sources and generation method.
howto.when_en: Use it when parsed documents and intent must become traceable cards, or when running run_four_color_cards.py with stages such as extract, review, or propose.

say_en.text: Turn this document into the four-color cards
say_en.note: Produces blue, green, yellow and red cards

say_en.text: Which sources do these cards cite?
say_en.note: Green cites blue; red cites green and blue

say_en.text: LLM is unavailable — use the rule engine and label it
say_en.note: Yellow and red cards mark 'LLM not used'
